test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some Hammers are Screwdrivers.

No Screwdrivers are Wrenches.

All Wrenches are Pliers.

**Conclusions:**

**(I)** Some Wrenches are Screwdrivers.

**(II)** Some Screwdrivers are Pliers.
solution:
**Statements:**

Some Hammers are Screwdrivers.**
No Screwdrivers are Wrenches.

All Wrenches are Pliers.

**Venn Diagram Logic:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e55376c26e200228ee26b6bd42a79b2a803d323cf0a914c4f5e82bfc415649f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Wrenches are Screwdrivers: Does not follows **(Because no Screwdrivers are Wrenches.)

(II) Some Screwdrivers are Pliers: **False**(No direct relation is given between Screwdrivers and Pliers.)

Therefore, **neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

**Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows".**
